Game Overview

At its heart, Pumpkin Roll is a skill game about guide Mr. Pumpkin through a whimsical world where Halloween meets Christmas. Navigate complex puzzles, dodge obstacles, and uncover hidden gifts in three enchanting realms. With your wits and skills, embark on a delightful journey filled with festive challenges and endless fun. Can you reunite Mr. Pumpkin with his holiday treasures?

Pumpkin Roll keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide Mr. Pumpkin through a whimsical world where Halloween meets Christmas.
